data.markdown:
# Traffic drop in the South due to power failure at site S-SUD-006

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-SUD-006`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct alarms (mains failure, battery low, site down) match the timing of the traffic and availability drops, and maintenance, external events, and changes were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-30 16:30 to 2026-09-30 18:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-30 14:13
- **Affected:** S-SUD-006

## Summary

A mains power failure at site S-SUD-006 led to battery depletion and a complete site outage.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on site S-SUD-006 starting at 2026-09-30 16:30 and recovered at 2026-09-30 18:00 when power was restored.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-30 13:34: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm raised on S-SUD-006 [ALM-000687, T3]
- 2026-09-30 14:01: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm cleared on S-SUD-006 [ALM-000687, T3]
- 2026-09-30 14:13: Major MAINS_FAILURE alarm raised on S-SUD-006 [ALM-000688, T3]
- 2026-09-30 16:15: Major BATTERY_LOW alarm raised on S-SUD-006 [ALM-000693, T3]
- 2026-09-30 16:30: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-SUD-006 and traffic/availability drop begins [ALM-000694, ALR-0039, T1, T3]
- 2026-09-30 17:49: MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, and SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-SUD-006 [ALM-000688, ALM-000693, ALM-000694, T3]
- 2026-09-30 18:00: Traffic, active users, and availability drop alert (ALR-0039) ended [ALR-0039, T1]

## Evidence

- Site S-SUD-006 experienced a total traffic, active users, and availability drop from 2026-09-30 16:30 to 2026-09-30 18:00. [ALR-0039, T1]
- A mains failure occurred on S-SUD-006 at 2026-09-30 14:13, followed by a low battery warning at 16:15 and a complete site down alarm at 16:30. [ALM-000688, ALM-000693, ALM-000694, T3]
- No maintenance windows or changes occurred on S-SUD-006 and its parents during the incident window. [T4, T5]
- No external events were recorded for region SUD during the incident window. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-SUD-006: confirmed. Mains failure, low battery, and site down alarms directly coincide with the traffic and availability drops, supported by the absence of changes or maintenance. [ALM-000688, ALM-000693, ALM-000694, ALR-0039, T3]
2. **bad_change** at S-SUD-006: rejected. Change management logs show no changes on S-SUD-006 and its parents during the window. [T5]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-SUD-006: rejected. Maintenance logs show no planned maintenance on S-SUD-006 and its parents during the window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000687: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm cleared well before the traffic drop started and was unrelated to the site outage.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect the power supply and generator/battery backup systems at site S-SUD-006.
